cases.title: Bookstore leaflet needs a direction

expected_items.label: needs_clarification
expected_items.rationale: The phrase does not identify a concrete visual change, so the designer must ask what should change.

input.brief:
Client: Mosswick Books; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A5 reading-club leaflet, front and back.
Use the supplied copy and a two-colour palette.
Supply a print PDF and one web JPEG; two revision rounds are included.
First draft is due 19 October; final delivery is due 24 October.
Out of scope: copywriting, photography and additional page layouts.
input.message: Thanks for the draft. Can you make it pop more? I cannot quite put my finger on what is missing.

clauses.text: Client: Mosswick Books; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A5 reading-club leaflet, front and back.
Use the supplied copy and a two-colour palette.
Supply a print PDF and one web JPEG; two revision rounds are included.
First draft is due 19 October; final delivery is due 24 October.
Out of scope: copywriting, photography and additional page layouts.

items.request: Improve the visual appeal of the design.
items.message_quote: Can you make it pop more?
items.label: needs_clarification
items.reason: The request is vague and doesn't specify what 'pop more' means visually.
items.question: Could you please provide specific examples or describe what aspects of the design you would like to see improved (e.g., color contrast, typography, layout emphasis)?
